title: Kali's altar defiled
description: In the Mines, the player drops a bomb beside Kali's altar and jumps clear over it. The blast destroys the altar: "YOU DARE DEFILE MY ALTAR? I WILL PUNISH YOU!", and six spiders spill out of the statue's head.
